answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 27748 Country: India Title: My name is "Syed Nasser Ahmed", Is this name correct according to Islamic naming convention? Should "Abdul" be added before "Nasser" ? Question: As Salaam Alaikum, My name is "Syed Nasser Ahmed", Is this name correct according to Islamic naming convention? Should "Abdul" be added before "Nasser" ? Please Advise. Answer ID: 27748 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1676/1676/M=1431) Your name is correct. There is no need to add Abd before Nasser. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
